comparison.objective: Load a vial into a vacuum desiccator and restore a sealed vacuum state without disturbing powder.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled venting from gauge feedback, dome handling, vial placement, pumping, and stopcock sequencing.
comparison.success_condition: Vent rate stays under 12 kPa/s, vial reaches ring, final pressure is at most -90 kPa, stopcock shut, pump off, dome sealed.
comparison.reason: Tests fluid-system sequencing, gauge-mediated rate control, sealing, and sample transfer rather than impact fracture and debris recovery.
